disclaimer: Illustrative published fee schedules, collected 2026-10-28. Providers change fees by corridor, account type, and over time. These figures are representative published values for comparison and education, NOT quotes. Always check the provider's live price before sending money.

providers.name: Wise
providers.note: Converts at the mid-market rate; charges a transparent conversion fee that varies by corridor (roughly 0.43%-1.5%). 0.65% used here as a representative mid value.

providers.name: PayPal (international commercial)
providers.note: International commercial transaction fee plus a currency-conversion spread of about 3% over the base exchange rate.

providers.name: Payoneer
providers.note: Receiving-marketplace payments plus a currency conversion margin of up to ~2% over mid-market.

providers.name: Remitly (economy)
providers.note: Low or zero headline fee on economy transfers; the margin lives in the exchange rate, typically ~1-2% off mid-market.

providers.name: Bank SWIFT wire (typical retail bank)
providers.note: Outgoing international wire fee at a typical retail bank, plus a retail FX spread of ~3-4%. Intermediary banks may deduct more en route; not modeled here.
providers.source: typical US retail bank wire fee schedules (representative)

providers.name: Cash pickup agent network
providers.note: Agent-network cash pickup: modest send fee, exchange rate typically ~2-3% off mid-market.
